source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40; Schedule of Credits line 12 (PDF p.29; bundle PDF p.7)

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 30,000.00 + wages person 1 30,050.00 = 60,050.00. Federal taxable income = 60,050.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 28,550.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 60,050.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 60,050.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 60,050.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 60,050.00, in the band 40,001 to 80,000: 2,150.00 each; 2 exemptions x 2,150.00 = 4,300.00. Line 5 = 60,050.00 - 4,300.00 = 55,750.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 55,750.00. Line 8a tax: 55,750.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (55,750.00 - 26,050.00 = 29,700.00) = 342.00 + 816.75 = 1,158.75. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 1,158.75. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 60,050.00 - 4,300.00 = 55,750.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: no covered retirement income, 0.00. Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 11 = 1,158.75 - 0.00 = 1,158.75. State income tax 1,158.75. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 1,159; expected keeps the formula result. The form gives the joint filing credit: each spouse has at least 500 of qualifying income, MAGI less exemptions 55,750 is in the 10% row, 10% x 1,158.75 = 115.875, tax 1,042.875. The projection does not model it, so expected stays 1,158.75.
accepted_approximations: The joint filing credit is not applied (not_modelled).
